snippet.title: Sonic Colors Demastered - v0.5.4 SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
#sage2025 #sonic #fangame
Happy SAGE everyone! While I wasn't able to get Asteroid Coaster ready for this year's Expo, I still had time to work on some small updates and improvements for the game that were enough to warrant a new demo. Plus, this demo DOES add the new jukebox mode, which is a pretty major addition! S-Rank stages to collect new tunes and blast through levels Super Sonic Style!

(also, it's worth noting but unlike previous demos, this one will NOT automatically upgrade your save data. If you start a new game with save data from a previous demo on your computer, it will get deleted. There's a new "New Game+" option available in the game that will make so you don't have to replay all the early game content to get to the newer stuff though)

Patch Notes for this update are available here:
https://randomocity-gaming.itch.io/sonic-colors-demastered/devlog/1035873/v054-patch-notes

You can check out our SAGE booth and download the game using the links below.
 
Happy Gaming!

Game Links:
SAGE Booth: https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-colors-demastered-sage-25-demo.2726/
Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/sonic-colors-demastered/764823
